description: Roadmap Governance and Lifecycle Sync - Maintain deterministic roadmap pointer consistency and lifecycle transition semantics.
changeLog: 2026-02-27: Activated PRD-033 from roadmap M8 governance milestone.
2026-02-27: Initialized PRD-033 user stories and research topics for lifecycle pointer synchronization and changelog governance.

userStories.title: Keep roadmap pointers aligned with execution state
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want `currentMilestone` and `currentPRD` pointers to always reflect actual PRD/milestone status so automation never misroutes work.
acceptanceCriteria: `currentMilestone` and `currentPRD` are updated according to deterministic lifecycle rules
No contradictory roadmap pointer state remains after updates
researchTopics: Current pointer update logic and state ownership boundaries in roadmap lifecycle flow
userStories.notes: Anchored to PRD-033 goal: deterministic pointer synchronization.

userStories.title: Enforce deterministic lifecycle transition ordering
userStories.description: As an orchestrator, I want lifecycle transitions (`prd_activated`, `prd_completed`, `milestone_completed`) to follow a consistent deterministic sequence so PRD queue progression is reproducible.
acceptanceCriteria: Lifecycle transitions (`prd_activated`, `prd_completed`, `milestone_completed`) follow a consistent sequence
Contradictory states (for example, completed milestone still marked active) are prevented
researchTopics: Canonical lifecycle transition sequence and guard conditions for roadmap state changes
Existing milestone closure and PRD activation/completion interactions requiring normalization
userStories.notes: Depends on PRD-032 policy enforcement semantics.

userStories.title: Stabilize lifecycle changelog semantics
userStories.description: As an auditor, I want roadmap changelog lifecycle actions to be complete, stable, and machine-consumable so governance events are traceable and replayable.
acceptanceCriteria: Changelog format remains stable and machine-consumable for orchestration tools
Lifecycle actions are fully captured in an auditable format
researchTopics: Current roadmap changelog action taxonomy and payload field consistency
Deterministic formatting rules for lifecycle event auditability and replay
userStories.notes: Covers changelog governance objective in PRD-033.
